col.title: Take
detail.not_checked_body: an gajarta bayanin ko ba a ambaci wannan ba. An ɗauka a matsayin ba a sani ba, ba a matsayin kasawa ba.
detail.contained_body: kalmar hanawa ta yi daidai da wani take mai tsayi. Duba wannan kafin ka amince da hanawar.
voice.profile_from: An koyi salon magana daga {count} na saƙonnin da kake aikawa
voice.no_profile: Babu bayanin salon magana tukuna — ƙara wasu daga cikin imel ɗin da ka aika
draft.send_ready: A shirye don aikawa daga manhajar imel ɗinka
draft.never_sends: Dawnlist ba ya aikawa da kansa. Kai ne za ka aika.
board.title: Dawnlist — allon aikinka
onboarding.drop_hint: Zubar da fayilolin CV ɗinka a nan — PDF, Word ko rubutu mai sauƙi
onboarding.calibration_body: Ga sanarwa goma na yanzu, tare da abin da Dawnlist ta fahimta daga kowanne. Gyara duk abin da ta yi kuskure. Inda ba ka yarda ba, gaya mata wace jimla za ta yi daidai — wannan jimlar za ta shiga cikin taƙaitaccen bayaninka, domin kada a sake yin irin wannan kuskuren gobe.
onboarding.sentence_placeholder: Wace jimla, idan aka ƙara wa taƙaitaccen bayaninka, za ta yi daidai a nan?
onboarding.finish: Kammala kuma fara gudu kowace rana
onboarding.ready: A shirye — an sabunta taƙaitaccen bayaninka da abin da ka koya masa.
onboarding.low_signal: Ka yarda da komai, wanda yawanci yana nufin wannan samfurin ya kasance mai sauƙi maimakon cewa taƙaitaccen bayanin ya cika.
onboarding.disagreement: Ba ku yarda ba — Dawnlist ya ce {app}, ku kuma kuka ce {user}.
onboarding.title: Dawnlist — saiti
